test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 7 Oct 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: A can do one-fourth of a work in 5 days and B can do two-fifth of the work in 10 days. In how many days can both A and B together do the work?
solution:
**Given**

A's complete 1/4th of work = 5 days

B's complete 2/5th of work = 10 days

**Concept**

1) Total work is the L.C.M of days taken by A and B

2) Work = efficiency × Time

or Efficiency = work/time

**Calculation**

A complete a work = 5 × 4

⇒ 20 days

B complete a work = 10 × (5/2)

⇒ 25 days

Total work (L.C.M of 20 and 25) = 100 units

A's one day work = 100/20

⇒ 5 units

B's one day work = 100/25

⇒ 4 units

Together A and B complete a work in one day = 5 units + 4 units

⇒ 9 units

Number of days taken by A and B together to complete a work = 100/9

⇒ 11{1over9} days.

**∴ A and B together can complete a work in 11{1over9} days.**
